preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Contract must have accumulated token balance from fees

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, set _percentageOfLiquidityForMarketing to a value greater than 100 (e.g., 150). This will cause the marketingFee calculation in swapAndLiquify() to exceed the total BNB balance, diverting all BNB to marketing/investing wallets instead of adding liquidity. Then trigger swapAndLiquify by transferring tokens to accumulate fees, causing the contract to swap tokens for BNB and send most/all BNB to the marketing/investing wallets (which you control).
